title: feat(studio): the App Studio list page draws decision 7's layout, and New on a read-only base says it creates into the .custom package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2kRNNd8UR35wDQqCUcVVEy)_
Fixes #37918
Fixes #37580
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：App Studio 里每类元数据的列表页换成新样子：标题行是图标、名称、「新建对象」这类按钮和帮助，下面一行只有来源下拉（全部 / 已修改和新建 / 系统自带）和搜索；面包屑、数字卡片、刷新和排序下拉去掉，点列头排序；表格铺满，名称列带对象自己的图标颜色，业务名在上、接口名小字在下；只读软件包的「新建」仍可点，悬停说明新建的东西会放进它的定制包。设置里的列表不变。
- 为什么做：App Studio 改版专题里列表页这一项，按你定的第 7 条（列表页）和第 8 条（只读提示）做；并入了原先「只读包里新建按钮置灰」那张卡，实测那张卡的前提不成立，所以不置灰、只加说明。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是 Studio 列表的列、来源标签或来源筛选显示不对；不动数据，可以直接撤回这次改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

The list a metadata type draws inside the App Studio area (the area host is present, outside Setup) is rebuilt to decision 7 and decision 8 of topic #37424:

- **Title row** (`StudioListHeader.tsx`, new): the type's icon, its name, the page's actions with **New X** last (`engine.list.createNamed`: "New Object" / 新建对象), and the console's help menu (`HelpMenu`, reused), then the Studio title-row end (Save / assistant). No breadcrumb, no stat tiles, no refresh. The invalid / warning counts sit beside the title as Setup draws them, not as tiles.
- **Toolbar**: the source dropdown (all / modified and new / system-shipped, each with its count) and the search box; the activation status filter only where the scope has one. The sort dropdown and the "only customizations" toggle are gone; the column headers sort, and the Name header sorts by API name, the list's default order, so an untouched list shows its arrow there.
- **Table**: full-bleed (`-mx-6 border-t`, no rounded frame). The name column draws `ObjectIconTile` (an object's own `icon` and `color`) or `NeutralIconTile` for other types, the label as the primary line and the API name small and mono below. A column of numbers (a served `count` column, or one whose values are all numbers) is right-aligned through the grid column's spec `align`. The object list drops the plural label column. "Modified at" and "Source" are drawn only when the list's rows do not all show the same value there.
- **Source words** (`studioListSource.ts`, new): 系统自带 / 已修改 / 新建 (`engine.list.source.{system,modified,new}`). A row is Modified when the base's customization read lists it as an override, New when it is the pair's other item or authored at runtime, System-shipped otherwise. The in-cell customization mark is not drawn twice in the Studio list (the badge carries it, with the mark's title); the cross-package leg still names a pair row's base.
- **Read-only hint on New** (folds #37580): on a read-only base whose New creates into the base's `.custom` pair (`host.pairCreate`), New stays enabled (ADR-0146 D3, #36897) and gets a tooltip, plus an `aria-describedby` copy, from the new key **`engine.list.createInPairHint`**: "{package} is read-only. A new {type} is created in its customization package, {pair}." / 「{package} 是只读软件包，新建的{type}会放进它的定制包 {pair}。」. No per-list banner. A writable package's New is unchanged.

### Mapping the PM asked for

- **Source filter.** The address keeps its existing values (`metadataListState.ts` unchanged): `all` = all, `runtime` = modified and new, `artifact` = system-shipped. The assumption that the existing values map onto the three does not hold on the provenance alone: a served override is served under the base's id, so its provenance reads `artifact` and it would land under "system-shipped". In the Studio list a row's filter value is therefore read from its customization mark first, then its provenance (`studioListSource`), and the detail's ‹ › order (`useListOrderedNames.ts`) reads the same function, so the two cannot disagree. `?customized=1` is folded into "modified and new" there and read by neither the list nor ‹ ›.
- **Badges.** The old Source badge words (代码包 / 运行时) and the customization marks (已定制（X） / 新增) are neither decision 7's words, so three new keys carry them; the old keys stay for Setup and the shell.
- **Icon and colour.** On the listed object items already (the object list item is the object body: the same rows the `fields` count column reads). No extra fetch.
- **New tooltip key.** `engine.list.createInPairHint` (en + zh). `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint` is untouched.

### What the other hosts draw after this change

- **Setup** (`useInSetupApp()`, including Setup's access directory, which mounts a host too): unchanged — its own `PageHeader`, its filter chips, the sort dropdown, the plain "New", the plural label column.
- **The list outside Studio and Setup** (no host): unchanged — `PageShell` with breadcrumb, stat tiles, refresh and sort.
- **Studio's cross-package leg** (`~all`, host with no package): gets the Studio layout, like the per-package area.

## Tests

- New: `ResourceListPage.studio-37918.test.tsx`, 17 cases — every line of decision 7 (each removed element asserted absent; header sort; full-bleed; icon tile and colour; label above mono API name; right-aligned numbers; no plural label; a description stays one line in the grid cell, with no two-line clamp inside it), both directions of the Modified-at / Source hiding, the three badge words, both source narrowings and the ‹ › order under them, and decision 8 (tooltip names the package and the pair, `aria-describedby`, New still opens the create; the writable control; no banner). Setup and the no-host shell are controls.
- Updated, because they pinned the layout decision 7 retires: `ResourceListPage.pairCreate-36897.test.tsx` and `DirectoryPage.allTypes-37360.test.tsx` (the New button is "New X" in the area), `ResourceListPage.objectExtensionName-29569.test.tsx` and `metadataAreaHost.customizations-28568.test.tsx` (marks read as Source badges; "only customizations" as the source filter's "modified and new"; the label leads the row).
- Ablation of the tooltip (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `createInPair && host?.packageId && pairId` → `false`): the decision 8 case went red (1 failed / 15 passed), restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- Ablation of the description fix (anchor `return inSetup && c.key` → `return (inSetup || studioList) && c.key`, on the committed blob `7811242e58`): the one-line description case went red (1 failed / 16 passed); restore proven by blob == HEAD.
- Fix from the screenshots (`ce54f7b8fa`): the Studio list had extended Setup's two-line description clamp, but inside the grid's no-wrap cell the clamp never wraps and hides the cell's ellipsis, so a long description was cut mid-glyph at the column edge. The Studio list keeps the grid's one-line truncation (with its ellipsis); Setup keeps its clamp.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- Card files at the final head `ce54f7b8fa`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the five list files plus `ResourceListPage.setupLabelFirst-27356.test.tsx` (Setup's clamp) → `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 63 passed (63)`; app-shell `type-check` in the same locked run → lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- At `a7868d24e8` (the merge of `origin/main` after it touched none of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/{metadata-admin,studio-design}`, `ui/packages/i18n` or `packages/spec`): `packages/i18n/` + the product-neutral ratchet + every test file that names `ResourceListPage`, `MetadataResourceListPage`, `StudioMetadataArea`, `useListOrderedNames`, `ResourceDetailHeader` or `metadataListGrid` (53) + the new file → `Test Files 161 passed (161)`, `Tests 2654 passed | 13 skipped`; `DataPillar.pairActions-30088.test.tsx` (the one other user of the list's test ids) → `8 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`) → lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablations: description fix `Tests 1 failed | 16 passed (17)`; tooltip `Tests 1 failed | 15 passed (16)`, the failing case is "on a read-only base with a pair, New is enabled and its tooltip names the package and the pair".
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `ce54f7b8fa` (same 38 as at `cd5f300619`): 38 families, all run, all exit 0; `--ran` → "38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots (Chromium, dsf 2, 1440×900, zh-CN, light and dark, showcase app at `ce54f7b8fa`, Studio of the read-only `com.example.showcase` with its `.custom` pair): Objects with every row system-shipped, so Modified-at and Source are hidden (`a-all-system-light.png`, `a-all-system-dark.png`); Reports with one override and one new report in the pair, so both columns show with 系统自带 / 已修改 / 新建 (`b-modified-new-light.png`, `b-modified-new-dark.png`); Objects hovering 新建对象, showing the decision 8 tooltip (`c-new-hint-light.png`, `c-new-hint-dark.png`) (`objectstack-seat3/shots-37918/`).
- Seen in the shots, not fixed here (outside the claim's files): the title row's type icon and a non-object row's tile come from the list registry's icon (an object's title draws a cylinder; a report's title draws the generic layers icon and its rows draw cylinder tiles), while the Studio menu beside it draws its own table of type icons (a grid for objects, a bar chart for reports), which is not exported. Named in the report for the seat.
- **Surface beyond the claim, named:** `useListOrderedNames.ts` (the detail's ‹ › reader, so it reads the Studio source the list reads), `metadataListGrid.ts` (one optional `alignRight` on the grid column) and the four existing test files above. `HelpMenu` is reused from `layout/`, not edited.
- Sorting by label is no longer offered from the Studio list's headers: the Name column sorts by API name (the mockup's order and the default). An old `?sort=label` address still decodes and sorts, with no header arrow.
- The hide-when-uniform verdict reads the list's whole scope, before the search and the source filter, so a column does not come and go while the reader types.
- The served object list layout (spec `METADATA_LIST_REGISTRY`) still declares `pluralLabel`; the Studio list drops it on the console side and Setup still draws it. No spec edit (ruled out by the dispatch).
- A writable package's own items classify as `artifact` (they carry a real package id), so where they share a list with runtime rows the badge would read System-shipped; on a writable package with no pair every row reads the same and the column hides. Observation, not filed.

## Verification

First read (by risk): `ResourceListPage.tsx` — the `studioList` gate, `sourceOf` in the row reader and the `showChangedColumn` / `showSourceColumn` verdicts; `useListOrderedNames.ts` — the reader's `source`; `studioListSource.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.studio-37918.test.tsx` → 16 passed. In the running console, open App Studio on an installed (read-only) package with a `.custom` pair, Objects: one toolbar row (source dropdown, search), "New Object" whose hover says the item goes to the `.custom` package, and Modified-at / Source columns only when something is modified or new.
